coreMemory.english: v. to place something somewhere or express it in words；v. put into a certain place or abstract location
coreMemory.structure: put something down /ˈpʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈdaʊn/（放下；写下某物）；put something into practice /ˈpʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈɪntuː ˈpræktəs/（把某事付诸实践）；put something in context /ˈpʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ˈkɑntɛkst/（把某事放入语境）；put off doing something /ˈpʊt ˈɔːf ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（推迟做某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ put off to do something → ✅ put off doing something；❌ put something practice → ✅ put something into practice

commonErrors.note: “put off doing something”是需要动词 -ing 形式的固定结构；doing 是占位符，应换成具体动词的 -ing 形式。
在“put something into practice”这个常用搭配中，介词 into 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

synonyms.difference: place 侧重“放置；安放”。对应的常用英文义是 “to place something somewhere or express it in words”。put 在本卡搭配“put something down”中表达“放”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“放”这个义项下，remove（移走；去除）与 put 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of put”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。
